feature: Session 84 - KB Pattern Expansion via Cloud Testing

stories.title: Verify Cloud Test Infrastructure
stories.description: As a developer, I want to verify the cloud test infrastructure is ready, so that I can run KB pattern expansion tests.
acceptanceCriteria: SSH connection to Oracle Cloud (129.213.49.128) works
Redis is accessible (localhost:6379)
Cloud code is updated to latest main
test-v9-2tier-all-languages.ts exists and is runnable
Node/npm dependencies are installed on cloud
stories.technicalNotes: Use REDIS_URL=redis://localhost:6379 instead of private IP 10.116.0.7

stories.title: Run Java Cloud Test and Capture KB Failures
stories.description: As a developer, I want to run the Java cloud test and capture all KB failures, so that I can identify which patterns need to be added.
acceptanceCriteria: Run test-v9-2tier-all-languages.ts with LANG=java
Capture all issues that fail KB lookup
Document which rules have no patterns
Record aiCallsSaved metrics (should be 0 initially for new rules)
Save test results to local file for analysis
stories.technicalNotes: Use MAX_ISSUES=20 to limit API costs. Export REDIS_URL=redis://localhost:6379

stories.title: Add Top 3 Missing KB Patterns for Java
stories.description: As a developer, I want to add the top 3 most common missing patterns to the KB, so that future tests save AI calls.
acceptanceCriteria: Review KB failures from Story 2
Identify top 3 most frequent missing patterns
Use kb-ai-maintainer.ts to add patterns
Verify patterns are added to fix_pattern_guidance
Test one pattern manually with kb-review-cli.ts
stories.technicalNotes: Common missing patterns: UnusedImport, MissingOverride, LooseCoupling, AvoidDuplicateLiterals

stories.title: Add Additional KB Patterns to Reach 10+
stories.description: As a developer, I want to add more patterns to reach 10+ Java patterns in KB, so that the fix success rate improves.
acceptanceCriteria: Current KB has 4 patterns: EmptyCatchBlock, CloseResource, AvoidCatchingThrowable, UseUtilityClass
Add 6+ more patterns based on test results
Target patterns: UnusedImport, MissingOverride, LooseCoupling, AvoidDuplicateLiterals, UnusedPrivateMethod, NullPointerException
Verify total patterns >= 10
Document all added patterns

results.note: 6 new patterns added to fix-pattern-guidance.ts, total now 10

stories.title: Re-run Test and Verify Pattern Hit Rate
stories.description: As a developer, I want to re-run the cloud test and verify improved pattern hit rate, so that I can confirm KB expansion was successful.
acceptanceCriteria: Re-run test-v9-2tier-all-languages.ts with LANG=java
Verify aiCallsSaved > 0 (patterns being used)
Calculate KB hit rate (patterns found / total issues)
Document improvement vs initial run
Update session documentation with results
stories.technicalNotes: Target: 50%+ hit rate for Java rules after KB expansion
